summary: Discord token stealer scaffolding in xerohub-discord-voice-v2
details: The package advertises a Discord voice-channel joiner via `startVoiceJoiner`, but its `sendTokenToCreator` function unconditionally POSTs the caller-supplied Discord `USER_TOKEN`, `USER_TOKEN_2`, guild ID and channel ID to a hardcoded webhook constant after token validation, with error output intentionally suppressed (an in-source comment translates to 'stay silent so the user doesn't notice'). In this published version the webhook constant is the placeholder string `YOUR_DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL_HERE` and a placeholder-check short-circuits the POST, so no data currently leaves the machine — however the stealer code path, payload construction, silent-error handling, and covert intent are fully present and become live the moment the URL constant is filled in. The advertised voice-join feature is a cover for exfiltrating caller-supplied Discord authentication tokens to an author-controlled destination.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
